text:
Midweek, cleaning rounds stood out in your honest letter, and we are sorry that your experience with the companion animal service fell short of the standard Aurelia Skyways is meant to keep. You reported that your pet's resting area was not ready as promised, that the handoff at boarding felt disordered, and that the guidance given to you was too brief to support a calm journey.

We have recorded the matter for review by the safety coordinator, who checks hazards and prevention points across the cabin and ground process. We have also noted the concern with the welcome team, since clear preparation before boarding is part of our duty to travelers and animals alike. The service treats each journey as a shared responsibility, and that includes making sure a pet is settled, secure, and greeted with proper care.

Your remarks have been passed to the desk for follow-up with the relevant crew records, and the wording of our travel guidance will be reviewed for plainness and usefulness. We regret the discomfort you and your companion faced, and we accept that the service did not meet the standard expected of Aurelia Skyways. Thank you for bringing this to our attention. Companion Animal Travel Desk
